answer: Audits are recorded in pigment, queued in falcon, and plume publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 74 identities per epoch. A farm of 110 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1934 identities would post 3807 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
